notes.title: 0.4.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted item spawn rate. There should be much more loot in earlier dungeons now
[*] Hungry! - Goblins now start out as Hungry, having 85 maximum stamina. If you eat something, you get your stamina up to 100 again plus the bonus from the food itself! 
[*] “Depth -1F” now has an additional place to travel to
[*] Made Bucket Upgrade shop sign a bit clearer. Looks less like a medbay now.
[*] Added a sign for the Pawn Shop (where you sell stuff)
[*] Durability on some weapons have been adjusted
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed lobby unlock area not being accessible if a player joins after it is unlocked
[*] Fixed rendering issues in Prison
[*] Fixed various graphical issues in dungeons
[*] Fixed bucket upgrades not being removed properly after game over
[*] Fixed issue causing items to break if two players pick it up at the same time
[*] Fixed issue your arms would animate in a running animation when holding items
[*] Fixed chat not properly showing when a player joins or leaves the game
[*] Fixed Blast Potion not triggering its effect when thrown at an enemy
[*] Fixed a bug where the Rewards Chest during gambling could get stuct in its animation
[*] Fixed chat sending message when pressing ESC during typing
[*] Fixed changing items with keyboard while typing in the chat
[*] Adjusted skeleton walking animation speed. Now it should look better and less running in place.
[*] Various AI behaviour fixes
[/list]
… And other small fixes here and there!

notes.title: Exploration update 0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Randomized dungeons!!! [/h2]

[h3][i]Every delve is now even more different than before[/i][/h3]

[i]The first iteration of randomized dungeons are now finally in the game!! We've been hard at work designing and building a solid foundation for dungeon randomization that we believe will add a lot to the Pit of Goblin experience by making every delve even more unique than before!

It is still in an early phase but we hope to keep iterating on the randomization based on your feedback and fix any new bugs that may have surfaced. Still, we hope you enjoy exploring these new unique dungeons as much as we have! 

Additionally, more content such as new enemies and items are being worked on and will be added as soon as they are ready! Please look forward to it!

/ David, Kristian, Krab & Johan[/i]

[h3]Dungeons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dungeon Randomization(!!!)
[*] New Secret rooms added
[*] New Looting rooms and areas added to existing dungeons
[*] Bonfires and wall torches are now dynamically placed in the dungeons. Some dungeons may be darker and lighting your own way matters more than ever!
[*] Depth 3 now contains bigger and deadlier versions of previous dungeons (But of course, with more loot!)
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Item: Short Torch
[*] Long Torches now burn out faster
[*] Amount of times you can leave bread crumbs with bread has been increased
[/list]
[h3]Improvements and Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New rendering optimizations
[*] Network bandwidth optimizations
[*] Inventory and Item refactor, offering more stability
[*] There was an edge case where the player could cause items to disappear from the bucket, this has been fixed
[*] More intuitive fire, updated rules for what you can light your torch on. Feel free to light your torch on your friend's torch equipped on their back! 
[*] Correctly waits for animation to play before using items (such as eating food, using torch, putting on equipment )
[*] Torch no longer stuck in pointing state when pointing the torch and switching to another inventory slot
[*] Torch no longer stuck in pointing state when dropping the torch while pointing with it
[*] Lit torch correctly placed on back when picking up a big item.
[*] Improvements to pressure plate detection and network sync for all traps
[*] Various AI improvements and fixes to support dungeon randomization
[*] Fixed many issues with AI sometimes getting stuck in collision
[/list]

notes.title: Pit of Goblin in 2025: The Road to Release
notes.notes:
[h2]Pit of Goblin in 2025: The Road to Release[/h2]

It’s been just over a month since Pit of Goblin made released into Early Access, and we couldn’t be more thrilled with the journey so far. Over the holidays, we dropped a small winter content update to keep the festivities alive in the Pit, and we also took some much-needed time to recharge.

We’ve been back at work for a little while and wanted to share some updates with you! If you caught our Early Access roadmap, you already know we’ve got big plans, and the first content patch is just around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271762/6244b15c04a89807becb0adfe3f9b705a3e7fe86.png[/img]

[b]The Exploration Update[/b] is all about [i]Level Randomization[/i]! – A much requested feature, finally coming your way! Each dive into the Pit will be that little bit different adding to the challenge and excitement!

In addition to this patch we are also working on -
[list]
[*] Smarter, Trickier AI – Those nasties down in the Pit are going to behave a little different moving forward.
[*] Optimizations & Polished Gameplay – Making the Pit smoother than ever.
[/list]

Once the Exploration Update is live and solid, we’ll roll up our sleeves for the next big milestone: the [b]Goblin Mode Update[/b]. Trust us, you won’t want to miss what’s coming next.
Your support and feedback have been incredible and are what make this game so special. We’re building 
Pit of Goblin with the community, for the community, so keep those ideas and suggestions coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271762/a6c9a7b820bbbdf182dd24129816f9440914b371.png[/img]

If you want to leave feedback and suggestions, the discussion forums or our Discord is the best place to do that.

Thank you, as always, for your enthusiasm. We’ll see you back in the Pit soon. Get ready for what’s next!

notes.title: 🔥 PATCH NOTES FROM THE PIT 🔥 PIT OF GOBLIN DEMO 0.1.2

notes.title: 🔥 PATCH NOTES FROM THE PIT 🔥 PIT OF GOBLIN DEMO 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Oi, adventurers! The goblins here ‘ave cooked up some fiery fixes and tricks for yer next romp in our world. ‘Ere’s wot we’ve changed (or at least think we changed):

[list]
[*] [b]Fire Friendlier![/b] – Setting yer mates ablaze should be easier now... you know, for when they need a little "encouragement."
[*] [b]Buttons Be More Obvious [/b]– No more wonderin’ what does what – input hints are where they should be. Even the clumsiest goblin could figure it out.
[*] [b]Sensitivity Knob Twiddling [/b]– Mouse and controller sensitivity got a few adjustments. Yell at us if it still don’t feel right.
[*] [b]Less Annoyin’ Noises![/b] – Got rid of that sound repeat issue. Only the proper number of shrieks and squawks now.
[*][b] Sneakier Pathfindin’[/b] – We sent the AI goblins on a refresher course for getting around... mostly they learned something.
[*] [b]Fire Burn Time Tinkered [/b]– Made burning last just the right amount of time, so you’ll feel it... but not too much.
[*] [b]Less Network Yakkin’[/b] – Cut down on all that back and forth to keep things smoother than a goblin’s belly.
[*] [b]Can’t Hide Too Well[/b] – Don’t think crouching will get you out of sight so easily anymore. They’re onto yourr tricks!
[*] [b]Shiny New Goblin Eye Colors![/b] – We threw in a couple new eye hues for us goblins... purely cosmetic, but we’re feeling posh.
[*] [b]Weird Keyboards? [/b]– Got one of those strange layouts? We probably support it now. Goblins don’t judge.
[/list]

Now, get back in there and give it a whirl. And if you find anything that’s still busted, we’ll take a look (when we’re not napping, of course, jk devs don't sleep).
